pi-action reads them from `.pi/` with `trust_project: true` (not on pull requests from forks), else from `agent_dir`. To turn them off, set `system_prompt_files: false`. See [System prompt files](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.0/docs/prompts.md#system-prompt-files).
- **Images for pi-durable extensions** (#55, added in #71). pi-durable extensions get an image processor in their host options (`images`). With it, pit's `workspace.viewImage` can resize images that are too large, instead of rejecting them
